scoring_justification: Recomputing R²/RMSE from predictions.csv requires ground-truth test set oxidation state labels that cannot be bundled self-contained without having the paper's test set labels; we instead score the agent's reported R² and RMSE against paper targets with monotonic thresholds and add a structural audit of predictions.csv.

outputs.description: Per-sample test predictions. Checker performs a structural audit (correct columns, types). The primary scoring resides in metrics.json.
Agent's computed R² and RMSE from the test set predictions. Checker compares against hidden paper-reported thresholds (reference match) and cross-verifies consistency with predictions.csv.

output_contract.notes: The primary scoring is based on metrics.json meeting performance thresholds. predictions.csv is subject to a structural audit (correct columns and types) contributing a small weight.
